# Phase 6: Eight Maps and Three Game Modes

**Status: complete** (verified 2026-11-18). All maps are generated by code (`Assets/Scripts/Editor/Maps`), reuse the shared obstacle library, and are content-only scenes with `MapController` + `MapBootstrap`, so each works offline, online and on a dedicated server.

## 1. Maps

| # | Map | Category / fall rule | Highlights | Time |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Hammer Rush** | Race / respawn | Swinging hammers, sweeper bars, moving-platform gap, narrow bridge with hurdles, windmill ramp | 180 s |
| 2 | **Slime Mountain** | Race / respawn | Slippery slime ramps (friction 0.3), rolling boulders, bounce-pad ledges, backwards goo conveyor, summit ramp | 200 s |
| 3 | **Sky High** | Race / respawn | Floating hops, 8-tile vanishing bridge, drifting platforms, safe route vs risky bumper beam shortcut | 180 s |
| 4 | **Spin Attack** | Survival / eliminate | 30 m arena: big 30 m sweeper + fast counter-rotating bar, rim bumpers | 75 s |
| 5 | **Falling Tiles** | Survival / eliminate | Two 8×8 layers of tiles that drop after being stepped on (armed at GO) | 120 s |
| 6 | **Pendulum Panic** | Survival / eliminate | 5×5 platform grid with gaps, 6 hanging hammers, collapsing floor tiles | 90 s |
| 7 | **Crown Climber** | Final / respawn | 30-step spiral tower, vanishing steps, bumpers, tower hammers; first to the crown wins | 240 s |
| 8 | **Last Platform** | Final / eliminate | Tile arena collapsing from the outside in on a schedule, centre sweeper; last standing wins | 120 s |

New obstacles for these maps: `LoopingMover` (rolling balls), `TimedCollapse` (scheduled collapse with warning blink), plus prefabs **RollingBall, CollapseTile, HangingHammer, ArenaSweeper**. `FallingTile.Armed` keeps tiles inert during countdowns.

## 2. Game modes

| Mode | Rounds | Players |
|---|---|---|
| **Classic Knockout** | Race (→62.5 %) → Survival (→50 %) → Survival (→50 %) → Final (1 winner) | 32 (bots fill) |
| **Quick Race** | One race; top half win | 24 (bots fill) |
| **Private Party** | Race → Survival → Final; owner starts; bots optional | up to 32 |

Map selection picks a random map of each round's category without repeats.

## 3. Rule added this phase

If a race round times out with **no** finishers, the quota qualifies by course progress (furthest checkpoint, then closest to the finish), so matches always continue.

## 4. Verification

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Content build | 8 map scenes + definitions; catalog map pool = 8 |
| `MapIntegrityTests` (×8) | ✅ each map: definition matches scene, ≥ 32 spawns all on solid ground, race maps have ordered checkpoints + finish, survival maps none, obstacles present, kill volume present, offline rig spawns a player that stays on the map |
| **Full Classic Knockout** (Fusion runner, 1 human + 31 bots) | ✅ 32 → 20 (Hammer Rush) → 10 (Spin Attack) → 5 (Falling Tiles) → 1 (Crown Climber), champion crowned |
| PlayMode total | ✅ **37/37** |
| Visual | Overview renders of every map reviewed (`Tools/unity.sh maps`) |

## 5. Deferred

* **Addressables delivery of maps** moves to Phase 9 (optimisation): maps currently ship in Build Settings, which keeps Fusion scene loading simple. Addressables settings already exist.
* **Hand-authored bot routes**: bots use checkpoint steering; the spiral and survival maps would benefit from authored waypoints (Phase 9 polish).
* Falling-tile state is triggered locally on each peer; server-replicated tile state is a Phase 9 networking polish item.
